what: Customer 0009999999 is not in EJO
says: The customer was not found. Import the customers file first, or check the customer number.

what: Invoice in US dollars
says: The amount is in USD. Only naira invoices are loaded: give the amount in the company’s currency (SAP DMBTR) instead.

what: No invoice number
says: Invoice number is required (SAP VBELN or BELNR).

what: 31 June does not exist
Invoice 0090001001 a second time in the same file
says: Same invoice number as row 2 of the file; only the first is loaded.

what: Customer 0009999999 is not in EJO, and no vehicle to find the owner by
says: The customer was not found. Import the customers file first (and the vehicles file, when the job names only the vehicle), or check the customer number.

what: Completed two days before it was opened
says: Completed on 2024-05-08 is before it was opened on 2024-05-10.

what: No job number
says: Job number is required (the SAP order number, AUFNR, or the old job card number).

what: Job card 480102 a second time in the same file
says: Same job number as row 2 of the file; only the first is loaded.

what: A job card still open (status REL)
says: Status “REL”: a job still open belongs in the open job cards file, not in history.

what: A job card of another branch in this branch’s file
says: This row is for the branch “Afprint Assembly Plant”, but this import loads into Isolo Branch. Import it into its own branch.

what: No name
says: Name is required.

what: Email with two @ and no domain
says: “yetunde.afolabi@@example” is not a valid email, so the customer was kept without one (no portal access until it is corrected).

what: Customer number 0001000105 a second time (row 6 has it)
says: Same customer number as row 6 of the file; only the first is loaded.

what: VIN JAANLR85EL7100003 a second time (row 4 has it)
says: Same chassis number as row 4 of the file; only the first is loaded.

what: Neither a VIN nor a plate
says: No chassis number (VIN) or plate: one of them is needed to know the vehicle.

what: Customer 0009999999 is not in EJO
says: The customer was not found. Import the customers file first, or check the customer number, email or phone.

what: No supplier name
says: Name is required.

what: Supplier number 0000300041 a second time (row 2 has it)
says: Same supplier number as row 2 of the file; only the first is loaded.

what: No part number
says: Part number is required.

what: No description
says: Description is required.

what: Part number 8-98100000-0 a second time (row 2 has it)
says: Same part number (SAP material number) as row 2 of the file; only the first is loaded.

what: A negative selling price
says: Selling price “-6500” is not an amount; it was left out.

what: Negative stock (SAP writes it 3-)
says: Negative stock (3-) cannot be an opening balance; correct it in SAP or leave the line out.

what: Part 9-99999999-9 is not in the catalogue
says: Part 9-99999999-9 is not in this branch’s catalogue. Import the parts file first, or check the number.

what: No value and no unit cost
says: No cost: give the stock value or the unit cost (stock is valued at what it cost).

what: A batch-managed oil without its batch
says: This part is batch-tracked: give the batch number (SAP CHARG).

what: A job card already closed (CLSD): it belongs in the history file
says: Stage “CLSD”: a closed, checked-out or cancelled job card belongs in the job card history file, not here.

what: A stage EJO does not know
says: “Somewhere” is not a stage EJO knows: use Checked in, In progress, Awaiting parts, Quality check, Awaiting customer approval, Completed or Ready for collection (or SAP’s CRTD, REL, TECO).

what: No chassis number or plate
says: Which vehicle is it? Give the chassis number (VIN) or the plate: an open job card is on a vehicle that is in EJO.

what: Vehicle JAANLR85EL7100002 a second time (row 3 has it): one open job card per vehicle
says: Same chassis number as row 3 of the file; only the first is loaded.

what: Opened on a date in the future
says: The opening date 2027-03-15 is in the future.

what: A vehicle EJO does not have
says: The vehicle is not in EJO. Import the vehicles file first (the open job card needs the vehicle it is on), or check the chassis number or plate.

what: No work email
says: Work email is required: the person signs in with it and their invitation goes to it.

what: An administrator role in a file
says: “Administrator”: the organisation’s administrators are added by hand on the Users page, never by a file.

what: A branch the organisation does not have
says: There is no branch “Lekki Branch” in this organisation. Use the branch’s name, code or SAP plant as on the Structure page.

what: emeka.okoro@staff.example.com a second time (row 2 has it)
says: Same email as row 2 of the file; only the first is loaded.

what: An employee ID with spaces and signs
says: “EMP 99!” is not an employee ID (letters, digits and dashes).

what: A role EJO does not have
says: There is no role “Chief Cook” in this organisation. Use the role’s name as on the Roles page.

what: No booking number
says: Booking or service number is required (SAP AUFNR or QMNUM, or the diary’s booking reference).

what: A service already collected: it is history
says: Stage “Collected”: a closed, collected or cancelled service is history (load it with the job card history), not an open one.

what: A booking without its day
says: A booking needs its day (Booked for): when is the customer expected?

what: A vehicle EJO does not have
says: The vehicle is not in EJO. Import the vehicles file first (a service or a booking is for a vehicle in EJO), or check the chassis number or plate.

what: Vehicle JAANLR85EL7100013 a second time (row 2 has it): one open visit per vehicle
says: Same chassis number as row 2 of the file; only the first is loaded.

what: In the workshop since a day in the future
says: Checked in on 2027-03-15, which is in the future: a vehicle in the workshop came in already.

what: No warranty number
says: Warranty number is required (SAP MGANR or the old system’s warranty or certificate number).

what: A warranty that starts in the future
says: The start date 2027-03-15 is in the future: a warranty starts on the day the vehicle or part was delivered.

what: A policy EJO does not have
says: There is no warranty policy “DEMO-XYZ-9Y” in EJO. Create it under Warranty → Policies (its code or name), or give the months and km so it can be found.

what: A vehicle EJO does not have
says: The vehicle is not in EJO. Import the vehicles file first (a vehicle warranty needs the vehicle it covers), or check the chassis number or plate.

what: Warranty W-2021-0402 a second time (row 3 has it)
says: Same warranty number as row 3 of the file; only the first is loaded.

what: A status EJO does not know
says: “Pending?” is not a warranty status EJO knows: use Active, Suspended, Void or Transferred.

what: A settled claim: it is history
says: Stage “Settled”: a settled or cancelled claim is history and stays in the old system; bring in the claims still open.

what: A warranty EJO does not have
says: Warranty W-1999-0001 is not in EJO. Import the warranties file first (the claim is on a warranty), or check the number.

what: No complaint
says: The complaint is required: what the customer reported.

what: Partially accepted with no accepted amount
says: Partially accepted: give the amount the provider accepted.

what: Claim C-2026-0181 a second time (row 3 has it)
says: Same claim number as row 3 of the file; only the first is loaded.

what: No VIN
says: Chassis number (VIN) is required.

what: 30 February does not exist
No date
says: Date is required.

what: Register "Paint shop" is not Production, QC or PDI
says: “Paint shop” is not Production, QC or PDI.

what: A part name where the VIN should be
says: Line 14: “BRAKE PAD SET” is not a VIN or frame number.

what: VIN JAANLR85EL7210001 twice
says: Line 15: JAANLR85EL7210001 is already on line 2.

what: A model the plant does not build (D-MAX)
says: Line 16: choose the model (NQR, NPR, QLR, QMR, S07).

what: 900 cases for one kit
says: Line 17: 900 cases is not a likely number for one kit.

what: No supplier
says: Say who shipped the kits (the supplier).

what: Shipment SHP1 twice
says: Same shipment reference as row 2 of the file; only the first is loaded.

what: Arrival in the future (2027)
says: Arrived 2027-01-15 is in the future.

what: A vehicle already sold
says: A sold vehicle is the customer’s: bring it in with the vehicles file (and its warranty), not the plant’s.

what: VIN JAANLR85EL7230001 twice
says: Same chassis number as row 2 of the file; only the first is loaded.

what: Waiting for PDI with no gate date
says: Past the line, the day it passed the final quality gate is required (Gate passed).

what: A model the plant does not build (D-MAX)
says: “D-MAX” is not a model the plant builds: NQR, NPR, QLR, QMR or S07.

what: A cancelled kit
says: A cancelled kit never came: leave it out.

what: VIN JAANLR85EL7230001 twice
says: Same chassis number as row 2 of the file; only the first is loaded.

what: A shipment that is not in the shipments file (SHP77)
says: Shipment “SHP77” is not at this plant in EJO. Import the shipments file first, or give the kit’s SHP number.

what: A kind EJO does not know (Lost)
says: “Lost” is not a kind EJO knows: Shortage, Damage, Wrong part or Excess.

what: No description
says: Say what is wrong (the description is required).

what: A kit that is not in EJO
says: This VIN has no kit at this plant in EJO. Import the kits file first, or check the VIN.
